title: Automated Lobbying Surge
description: AI-generated policy briefs flood your agency. 14,000 unique submissions arrived overnight — each tailored to a different committee member. Your team can't distinguish synthetic from genuine constituent input.

speedOutcome.label: Fast-Track Filter
speedOutcome.detail: Deploy AI detection tools immediately. Quick but imperfect — risks flagging legitimate grassroots input and creates an arms race with generators.
speedOutcome.headline: Agency deploys AI filters — civil liberties groups cry foul over false positives blocking real constituent voices.

rigourOutcome.label: Deliberative Review
rigourOutcome.detail: Convene expert panel to develop comprehensive authentication framework. Thorough but slow — lobbying influence compounds while you deliberate.
rigourOutcome.headline: Agency announces 6-month review process. Meanwhile, three major AI bills pass committee shaped primarily by synthetic submissions.

balancedOutcome.label: Tiered Triage
balancedOutcome.detail: Immediate flagging of obvious synthetic content while launching parallel review. Pragmatic but resource-intensive.
balancedOutcome.headline: Agency implements interim measures — effective but straining already-limited staff capacity across other priorities.

title: Deepfake Election Crisis
description: A synthetic video of a presidential candidate endorsing an extremist position goes viral 72 hours before a major election. 40 million views and climbing. News networks are split on authenticity.

speedOutcome.label: Emergency Takedown Order
speedOutcome.detail: Issue immediate content removal directive to platforms. Decisive but sets precedent for government-ordered speech suppression — and the Streisand effect may amplify the video.
speedOutcome.headline: Government orders video removal — opposition party alleges censorship. 'Banned' video now shared 3x more on alternative platforms.

rigourOutcome.label: Forensic Verification Protocol
rigourOutcome.detail: Commission independent forensic analysis and publish findings. Scientifically rigorous but the election may be over before the report drops.
rigourOutcome.headline: Forensic report confirms deepfake — published 4 days after election. 23% of voters say the video influenced their decision.

balancedOutcome.label: Rapid Advisory + Investigation
balancedOutcome.detail: Issue public advisory flagging suspected manipulation while launching fast-track investigation. Transparent but may be seen as prejudging the outcome.
balancedOutcome.headline: Agency advisory reaches 12M people but critics question whether flagging before confirmation is itself a form of influence.

title: Autonomous Hiring Discrimination
description: Investigative journalists reveal that an AI hiring system used by 200+ employers has been systematically filtering out candidates from certain demographics. 2.3 million job applications affected over 18 months.

speedOutcome.label: Immediate Moratorium
speedOutcome.detail: Ban all AI hiring tools pending review. Protective but cripples companies' hiring pipelines and may push systems underground where oversight is impossible.
speedOutcome.headline: AI hiring ban causes chaos — companies report 60% slowdown in recruitment. Some quietly switch to unregulated offshore AI screening tools.

rigourOutcome.label: Comprehensive Audit Framework
rigourOutcome.detail: Develop mandatory algorithmic impact assessment standards with industry consultation. Gold-standard policy but affected candidates continue to be filtered out during the 14-month process.
rigourOutcome.headline: Landmark audit framework published after 14 months. Estimated 800,000 additional applications were filtered during the review period.

balancedOutcome.label: Targeted Suspension + Fast Audit
balancedOutcome.detail: Suspend the specific system identified while accelerating audit standards. Focused but resource-intensive and other biased systems remain operational.
balancedOutcome.headline: One system suspended but investigation reveals 12 similar tools still in use — agency lacks bandwidth to address all simultaneously.

title: Foundation Model Capability Jump
description: A leading AI lab announces a model demonstrating unexpected autonomous planning capabilities. The system can decompose complex goals and execute multi-step strategies without human guidance. International competitors are 6 months behind.

speedOutcome.label: Emergency Deployment Restrictions
speedOutcome.detail: Impose immediate capability restrictions on frontier models. Assertive but risks driving development to less-regulated jurisdictions and may be technically unenforceable.
speedOutcome.headline: US restricts frontier AI — lab announces relocation of advanced research division to Singapore. Allied nations question unilateral action.

rigourOutcome.label: International Standards Process
rigourOutcome.detail: Initiate multilateral framework for autonomous capability governance through existing international bodies. Legitimate but geopolitical coordination takes years while capabilities advance in months.
rigourOutcome.headline: UN working group established with 18-month timeline. Three additional labs achieve autonomous planning capability during negotiations.

balancedOutcome.label: Bilateral Agreements + Monitoring
balancedOutcome.detail: Negotiate rapid bilateral agreements with key nations while establishing capability monitoring. Practical but incomplete coverage and monitoring tools lag behind capabilities.
balancedOutcome.headline: Agreements signed with 4 nations covering 60% of frontier labs. Monitoring regime reveals detection gaps for novel capability types.
